decision: Nine separate roof ventilation props for provisional static rooftop decoration, viewed at player scale from all sides. The supplied TRELLIS GLB is a 3x3 product sheet with 291,238 triangles in one mesh; the two PNG references establish the intended vent set and single-vent style. Measured empty coordinate gaps separate all nine without cutting any source faces. A 60-percent per-prop reduction keeps their silhouettes and broad detail; original-source trials show the remaining uneven grille bars predate reduction. Each export is split into mesh parts below Roblox's 10,000-triangle per-mesh limit and embeds PNG textures. Four-stud maximum footprint and decoration role are provisional. User visual approval, Studio import, and map integration are pending.
